title: SDMX codelist ACL00: HETUS activity coding list, with English labels
used_for: The labels for the activity codes the HETUS tables are keyed by. The tus_00* downloads carry codes only - 'AC331', 'AC33A' - with no text, so until this was registered the mapping from an HETUS code to a modelled activity rested on recollection of what each code means. One of them was wrong: laundry was mapped to AC33A, which this codelist gives as 'Handicraft and producing textiles and other care for textiles' (2 minutes a day), when laundry is AC331 (5 minutes) and ironing AC332 (4). The brief forbids hard-coded statistics from memory; a code-to-meaning mapping from memory is the same failure one step removed, and this closes it.
